# Drill Questions

## Notes to authors {-}

`r devoirs::push_answer_style("block")` <!-- turns on the display of answers -->

1. Drill questions should always have answers provided.
    
    In the `{devoirs}` markup language, answers are given as "hints." See the examples for how to install a hint.

2. Every question item should have a unique ID. You can make this up at random, but a good idea is to tie the ID to the chapter.

3. You also can give narrative answers in both *short* and *long* form. 
[This is an example of a short answer. See the markup in the source document.]{.shortanswer `r devoirs:::answer_style()` data-tooltip="Ans id: Drill-questions-6NN"}

<!-- Opening answer: Drill-questions-5cC -->
::: {.callout-tip collapse=true `r devoirs:::answer_style()`}

4. The block labeled "Remember to hand in your work ..." is inserted automatically on a document by document basis. You do not need to enter this as a question.
